latin: Licet natura intellectualis simul omnia intelligat, non tamen hoc est per uirtualem et unitiuam continentiam, sed per mutuam penetrationem formarum, et indissociatam concatenationem totius esse participati, id est, formalis.
translation: Although the intellectual nature understands all things at once, this is not through a virtual and unifying containment of them, but through the mutual interpenetration of forms and the inseparable chaining together of the whole of participated—that is, formal—being.
